title: Labeled behavior clips

title: End-to-end pipeline
alt: Flow diagram: input video goes through stabilization, YOLOv11-Pose detection and ByteTrack tracking, clip and metadata extraction, and X3D+MLP classification, then post-processing that outputs CSV files, annotated videos, heatmaps and trajectories.
caption: The pipeline: preprocessing, detection and tracking, feature engineering, action classification, analytics.

title: X3D + metadata fusion
alt: Architecture diagram: a 32-frame clip passes through an X3D-M backbone into 512 visual features while pose metadata (velocity, distance to equipment) passes through an MLP into 64 context features; the two are concatenated into 576 dimensions and fed to a five-class classifier (resting, walking, standing, drinking, eating).
caption: X3D video features fused with pose metadata through an MLP.

title: Identifying a card
alt: Three panels: a phone photo of trading cards on a desk with one card circled, the Siamese network's top-10 terminal output, and the matched card image labeled 'Top Guess (Correct)'.

title: Siamese network training
alt: Two line charts: accuracy of Siamese network predictions rising from about 69% to about 97% across four checkpoints, and training loss dropping from about 3.8 to near 0 over 20 epochs.
caption: Accuracy and loss charts for the Siamese card-matching network, from the team's results.

title: Detector training curves
alt: Ten small YOLO training plots: train and validation box, class and DFL losses falling, and precision, recall, mAP50 and mAP50-95 rising toward 1.0 over about 300 epochs.
caption: YOLO card-detector training: losses fall and mAP50 levels off near 0.995.

title: Results by model type
alt: Table comparing four Whisper variants. Dynamic INT8 encoder with FP16 decoder: 17% WER, 12.5 s, 381 MB total. INT8 encoder with FP32 decoder: 17% WER, 9.1 s, 674 MB. FP16: 18% WER, 29.0 s, 464 MB. FP32 baseline: 18% WER, 7.3 s, 925 MB.
caption: The team's results: the dynamic INT8 encoder is 88 MB versus 339 MB in FP32, with average WER unchanged (17–18%).

title: Size and inference time
alt: Two bar charts: stacked encoder and decoder size in MB for INT8+FP16, INT8+FP32, FP16 and FP32 models, and total inference time in seconds for each, with FP16 slowest at about 29 s.
caption: Encoder/decoder size and total inference time for each model type on CPU (ONNX Runtime).
